editorial:
The Devil's Mate is a 68-minute mystery from Monogram Pictures, released August 20, 1933. Phil Rosen directed. Leonard Fields and David Silverstein wrote it. Peggy Shannon and Preston Foster are in the cast. In the plot, a murderer named Maloney is being executed and is willing to expose an underworld mob boss, but a poison dart kills him before he can tell anything. Rosen later remade it as I Killed That Man (1941).

The rights trap is the print's status, which is not yet settled. Because the film dates from 1933, it is free only if its notice was missing or its renewal was never filed in the renewal year (calendar 1960-1961). This dossier did not search for either. Check the Catalog of Copyright Entries Motion Pictures volumes for 1960 and 1961 yourself before relying on any copy. The Copyright Office online records only cover post-1977 recordations, such as transfers, so they cannot show a 1960-61 renewal. The score and the source of the story are also unchecked.
